Titel: Senior Demand & Supply Planning Consultant (all genders) – S&OP / SAP IBP
Unternehmen: Veldmark Consumer Health B.V.
Ort: Lörrach-Nord (Deutschland)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4219034567/
Abgerufen am: 22.09.2026 08:15

About the role
Veldmark Consumer Health is a mid-sized manufacturer of over-the-counter products and food supplements with sites in the Netherlands, Germany and Poland. We are rolling out a harmonised Sales & Operations Planning process across all three markets and are looking for an experienced freelance consultant to lead the demand and supply planning workstream.

What you will do
- Design and roll out a monthly S&OP cycle (demand review, supply review, pre-S&OP, executive S&OP)
- Improve statistical forecasting in SAP IBP for Demand and define forecast accuracy and bias KPIs
- Align supply planning parameters (safety stocks, lot sizes, lead times) with the production and procurement teams
- Drive SKU rationalisation and inventory reduction without compromising service levels (target: OTIF above 95 %)
- Build planning dashboards together with the BI team (Power BI)
- Coach local planners in Germany and Poland and document the new process landscape

What you bring
- 7+ years of experience in supply chain planning, ideally in FMCG, consumer health or pharma
- Proven track record in S&OP / IBP implementations
- Hands-on experience with SAP IBP or SAP APO; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA PP/MM is a plus
- Strong analytical skills, advanced Excel; Power BI is a plus
- Experience working under GMP-regulated conditions is an advantage
- Fluent English; German is a strong plus for the Lörrach site

Engagement details
Start: mid October 2026
Duration: 9 months with option to extend
Workload: 4 to 5 days per week
Location: hybrid, 2 days per week on site in Lörrach, remainder remote
Rate: competitive daily rate, please state your expectation

Veldmark is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation.
